# `admin.user.delete`

Delete a user account

Site admins only. Tombstones the account until its purge horizon, revokes sessions and tokens, and soft-deletes user-namespace repos. Requires a current If-Match entity tag and a confirmation naming the account. Refuses the last active admin.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}/delete`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin user delete`
- MCP: `admin_user_delete`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `If-Match` | header | no | `string` |
| `confirm` | body | yes | `string` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `precondition-required`, `stale`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
